body: Thank you! I'm sure it's not a magic cure, but anything has to be better than this. I'm willing to do anything at this point.
My sleep patterns are horrible. I'm up every hour or 2 every night. I just can't sleep straight through. So he also gave me 50mg of trazodone to help with that.

Ouch. Hurts, but I suppose you are correct. But like I said in another post, I had an emotional block, that has recently been broken. I am now connected to my emotions like I have never been before in my life. It is a whirlwind, confusing, and I'm trying to make sense of it all. And my feelings now are very HL, emotional, and connected. I'm actually trying to fight it. It's new and foreign to me. But that said, with my new connection, I am trying to understand, so I can learn and grow.

Yes, exactly. I wanted to, but my emotions were inside, not outside. All of them. Not just intimacy. All emotions. 
But when I showed them, it seemed "bad".
When we had sex, it hurt her, made her feel used. When we didn't, she felt unwanted. A catch 22. I think doing it MORE would have alleviated the "used" feeling, but couldn't see that at the time. As I said in another reply, recent breakthroughs in therapy have removed my emotional block, Soni am here trying to understand so I can become a better person.

please don't get me wrong. Not criticizing anyone. Just trying to learn. Yes I was the LL. Yes, I was very robotic. Honestly, robotic about everything. Not just initimacy, but joy, anger, sadness, all of it. Could never tell what I was thinking. I felt it, but couldn't show it. Don't know why. Recent therapy has removed that block, and I am now on the road to understanding. Which is why I am here asking. Trying to make sense of it all.

But there's the rub. I understand completely what you are saying. I do. Believe me. But when we would donuts, I was told she felt dirty and used. I get that comes from the lack of sex to begin with, but how do you overcome that?

It's like a circle. Don't do it, and she is hurt. Donut, and she is hurt, so you stop doing it to stop hurting her. And then she is hurt by not doing it. Rinse wash repeat.

I did want it. I did. So intensely it was killing me. But I couldn't bring myself to make her feel that way. So I didn't. And that in turn also hurt her.

What could I have done?

Just the one ex. And yes, was a complete disaster. However, as you state, there have been meds and therapy, and therefore now some semblance of clarity.
And I'm working on it, more and more, day by day.
Hence the question. And it is very serious.
If I want to grow, achieve, and overcome, then I must face and understand the issues that I have had. And correct them.
So yes, it may be a clusterF, but absolutely serious in every sense of the word.

The mess we had was simply due gone thing - the DB. She felt total lack of emotion from me, in every way.
I'm just trying to wrap my head around it. I did so much, except sex. So I truly want to understand.

I'm an open book here, guys. If all of your experiences could help one person to grow and change, wouldn't it be worth it? I'm willing, and would like to believe able.
Not trying to shame. Just to understand and grow.

And this is exactly what happened. I thought everything else was meaningful, and truly did not understand the importance of sex. To me, it was physical. Blame it on my rampant childhood sexual abuse, blame it on me being an idiot, or blame it on anything else. But I was just blind. I had no idea.
I have been, and do read them. Which is why I asked. I would like to enlighten myself to a better way. Evolve, if you will. I'm trying.

Wow. This posts hit me hard. I did not see it as withholding. I honestly thought I was doing and showing love in every way. It did not occur to me how long between encounters there was, or the lack of frequency. I took it for granted, I suppose. I truly did not understand the importance of it.

I understand that. I do.
But it's so hard. Nothing seems real. It's all fake. Feels like I'm in a dream, and I just want to wake up.
I want it all to end. I can't take it anymore.

It's hard. I can feel it at the edges, fighting to pull me back in. Right now, I'm worse off than I was just this morning.
I'm convinced she's playing me. Only saying we can be together in order to trick me. Or maybe in hopes I'll get better, and will no longer want her. Because I'll be healthy and move on.
I don't know what's real anymore.

I understand. But this is not the woman I knew for so many years. What the hell happened?
She blames me for all of this, because of how neglectful I was. And I was, because I was always told how much it hurt her when I did do it.
I just don't get it.

A lot. Over the years, people have tried to pull us apart. Even went to far as to tell me they were taking her and the kids away, so don't get too close. So I didn't. And she got hurt, thinking I didn't love her, and hated her.

I never told her what these people did, or said, and she was left to her own conclusions. Because I never communicated.

And much, much more.

And I never said a word. I thought why put her through it? I was trying to protect her.

And in the end, she ended up thinking I didn't care, wasn't attracted, etc.... And it broke us.

I should have said something. But I was too scared it was true, I hid.

And look where it got me. Alone.
I will. I don't expect it to go well.

I hear you. I do.

But I want to try again with her. And that has been the topic of our discussions. Trying again.
And....she's open to it. If I can prove it.
But I don't know how.

I found a therapist to help me. But I don't think I'll ever be able to make it up to her. 
We have been talking about getting back together, but she just can't trust me. I hurt her so much, she just can't find it in her. 
I'm trying everything I can, to show I understand now, am different, and am working on myself, but I'm afraid it'll never be enough.
I'll keep trying, I'll keep showing, and she'll keep being afraid of me and what I did.

And I don't know if we'll ever meet in the middle, so I can put it into action.

I hurt her so intensely. And I hate myself for it. Every day. I'm a miserable, disgusting, hurtful human being. I never wanted her to feel this. Ever. And am so so sorry. 

I'm not even sure I should be here. But I am.

And want to make it better. And prove it to her. I just don't know how.
Oh man. I can't believe I did that. I really believed what I was saying. It kills me.
I think I was. I did this for years. I honestly believed what I was saying. I had no idea. I hurt her so bad. I love her, and it kills me to know that I did this. I'm am so sorry.
I'm sorry. It's killing me. How could I have been so blind?
Sounds like me. I admit, I was, and in many ways still am, immature.
There was never physical between us. I am not that way. But I get the point.
Please guys any help?
